'''Chollas''' were herd animals that grazed the plains on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]<ref name="TDC" /> and [[Kolatill]]<ref name="Omens" /> in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TDC" /> Around [[392 BBY/Legends|392 BBY]],<ref name="Settling">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' states that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] was settled "four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] ago." ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' to "eight years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]," for a date of Kal'Shebbol's settling to be established as [[392 BBY/Legends|392 BBY]].</ref> [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] settlers, escaping from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], domesticated the herds that roamed their adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Along with the development of [[Farm/Legends|farms]], the ranching of the chollas helped the Twi'leks to establish the basis of their new society.<ref name="TDC" /> 

By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' to "eight years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]," for a date of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> chollas were also reared on the neighboring planet of Kolatill. The ranching of both chollas and [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] was a large industry on the planet; the hides and meat of the chollas sold for decent sums of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in Kolatill's northern [[City/Legends|cities]]. Both the meat and hides were also exported off-world to the nearby planets of [[Gandle Ott]] and [[Torize]].<ref name="Omens" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chollas were first referenced in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. Chollas were mentioned in the information capsules for the planets Kal'Shebbol, located in the Kathol Sector Overview section,<ref name="TDC" /> and Kolatill, in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying adventure]] "[[Omens]]".<ref name="Omens" />

It is unknown if ''chollas'' is the plural or singular name of the species. The species is referred to as ''herds of chollas''; however, this article makes no assumptions as to whether or not the name is singular or plural, and lists it by the only name indicated.<ref name="Omens" />
